def solution():
    # Define variables
    bid_rates = [6.2, 6.4, 6.1, 6.5, 6.3, 6.4, 6.0, 6.1]
    offer_rates = [6.6, 6.7, 6.5, 6.8, 6.7, 6.8, 6.4, 6.5]

    # Calculate mid-rates
    mid_rates = [(bid + offer) / 2 for bid, offer in zip(bid_rates, offer_rates)]

    # Sort and remove the two lowest and two highest mid-rates
    mid_rates.sort()
    trimmed_mid_rates = mid_rates[2:-2]

    # Calculate the JIBAR rate and round to two decimal places
    jibar_rate = round(sum(trimmed_mid_rates) / len(trimmed_mid_rates), 2)

    # Return answer
    return jibar_rate
